architectureDecisions: D1 — Flag is --mcp-verify true on run and deliver. parseOptions already requires a value; do not add valueless booleans. Absent flag => mcpVerify stays default false. Present value must be the string true (UsageError otherwise). commandRun and commandDeliverCli pass mcpVerify: true into runSupervisedTask / runDeliverSlice only when that exact value is set. Never pass process.stdin/stdout; mcpVerify: true lets the supervisor allocate the internal PassThrough pair. DELIVERED_TRUTH: bin never mentions mcp; audit runCliPassesMcpVerify false, binMentionsMcp false, supervisorAcceptsMcpVerify true.

D2 — Deliver MCP is Backend-only. runDeliverSlice options gain mcpVerify=false. When true, pass mcpVerify: true into the two runSupervisedTask sites (runBackendFresh and recoveryDir===null). Do not start a server for QA (runQaOnFreshCheckout). Do not pass mcpVerify into resumeSupervisedTask (no such parameter). Missing-tool TOOL_UNAVAILABLE before spawn never constructs the server. supervisor.js already stop()s in finally before dispose on both default and recoverable first-run paths.

D3 — Keep the delivered tool set. Do not edit mcp-server.js. EXHARNESS_MCP_TOOLS is verify+status; FORBIDDEN_PATTERN /promote|accept|merge/i plus ALLOWED_TOOLS rejects planted names with MCP_FORBIDDEN_TOOL at construction. No MCP SDK. Opt-in cannot write .codex/.kiro/.gemini or change adapter argv (already asserted by mcp-server.test.js MCP3).

D4 — Tests in packages/agent-tools/test/operator-mcp-opt-in.test.js. P1: runSupervisedTask({ mcpVerify: true, fake FIX_FIRST }) completes ACCEPTED; createExharnessMcpVerifyServer ran (onHandleWrite or existing MCP3 pattern) and stop happened. P2: spawn BIN `run --mcp-verify true --tool codex --command fake --task` exit 0. P3: runDeliverSlice({ mcpVerify: true, fake }) Backend-only. N1: default runSupervisedTask / BIN run without the flag never constructs the server (reuse the lexical if (mcpVerify) proof plus BIN source has no mcpVerify key). N2: createExharnessMcpVerifyServer({ tools: ["exharness_verify", "exharness_promote"] }) throws TypeError code MCP_FORBIDDEN_TOOL. N3: default run does not write user CLI config and adapter argv equals the no-mcp control. Hermetic fake CLI; existing mcp-server.test.js MCP1–MCP3 stay green.

D5 — Living docs. mcp.md already describes runSupervisedTask.mcpVerify; add that `exharness-agent run|deliver --mcp-verify true` is the operator opt-in, default off, Backend worktree only, supervisor-owned stdio (not process.stdin), stop before dispose. operator.md USAGE gains --mcp-verify true. No Blackboard ids.
